summary: Prorated burst credits remain in pending state after Dedicated -> Hosted downgrade; credits not applied to current invoice
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightLoop AI downgraded from a Dedicated reserved capacity plan to Hosted on 2026-03-08 22:15 UTC. They expected prorated "burst" credits (unused reserved burst allocation) to be applied to their billing account immediately and to appear on the next invoice. The customer reports the credits are visible in the Console under 'Pending credits' but the invoice generated on 2026-03-09 does not include them, and their effective balance still reflects the pre-downgrade charge.

Impact:
- Invoice overcharged by the expected prorated burst credit (~$3,200) for billing period ending 2026-03-09.
- Customer-facing finance team has paused payments pending resolution.
- Customer reports this blocks month-end close and may delay renewal decision.

Timeline / Key events:
- 2026-03-08 22:15 UTC: Customer requested downgrade via Console (self-serve).
- 2026-03-08 22:16 UTC: System accepted downgrade; reserved capacity deallocated starting next billing period; burst credits calculation job queued.
- 2026-03-09 00:03 UTC: Invoice generated for billing cycle ending 2026-03-09.
- 2026-03-09 02:10 UTC: Customer noticed missing credit and opened support chat.
- 2026-03-10 09:30 UTC: SUP ticket created.

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) Spin up a dedicated org with reserved capacity and enabled burst credits.
2) Simulate partial consumption leaving unused burst hours.
3) Perform a downgrade to hosted via the Console UI at end of day.
4) Trigger billing pipeline / invoice generation for same cycle.
5) Observe pending credits state in Console and absence on generated invoice.

Expected behavior:
- Prorated burst credits should be computed and applied to the customer's account prior to invoice generation or included as an offset on that invoice.

Actual behavior observed:
- Credits appear in Console as 'Pending — prorated burst credit' but are not included on the invoice that was generated shortly afterwards. The billing system shows a pending_credits entry in the credits ledger with status "pending" and no action/settlement record.

Relevant logs / pointers:
- Billing ledger excerpt (billing service trace ID: trace-bill-20260309-2230).
- Console shows credit entry id: credit-PBR-20260308-9981 (status: pending).
- Billing job logs: https://logs.internal.redwood.ai/billing/job-20260309-0003 (access restricted).

Customer expectation and business ask:
- Provide immediate reconciliation and apply the prorated burst credit to current invoice or issue a credit memo.
- Confirm root cause and whether this will affect other customers who self-serve downgrade near invoice cutover.
- ETA for fix and any manual remediation steps for the customer.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Aisha Patel (Support): Logged initial ticket after chat with BrightLoop. Captured Console screenshot and invoice PDF. Assigned to billing ops for triage.

2026-03-10 | Billing Ops (Jared Morales): Looking into the billing run. Initial hypothesis: credit calculation succeeded but settlement job that converts pending credits into applied credits skipped when invoice generation job ran within same hour. Escalating to SRE to check job ordering in the billing pipeline.

2026-03-10 | SRE (Nina Kovács): Confirmed invoice generation executed at 2026-03-09 00:03 UTC. Settlement job for prorated credits scheduled at 2026-03-09 02:00 UTC but failed with database deadlock. Collected error snippet: "ERROR: deadlock detected while updating ledger entries". Creating INT ticket for DB contention investigation (INT-8412).

2026-03-11 | Marcus Chen (Billing Engineer): Performed manual settlement for credit-PBR-20260308-9981 and created credit memo CM-20260311-559. Applied to invoice INV-20260309-772. Notified BrightLoop with remediation notes. Pending follow-up for root cause and automation so future settlements are not manual.

2026-03-11 | BrightLoop (Elena Rios): Customer confirmed receipt of credit memo and that the invoice balance reflects the expected amount. Appreciative of manual remediation but requesting assurance this won't reoccur at end of month.

2026-03-12 | Marcus Chen (Billing Engineer): Added follow-up actions: 1) fix ordering in billing pipeline to ensure settlement runs before invoice finalization when downgrade events occur within 24 hours of invoice cut; 2) add idempotent retry for settlement job to recover from deadlocks; 3) write alert when pending credit remains after invoice issuance longer than 12 hours. Created INT-8430 for pipeline change and INT-8431 for alerting.
2026-03-12 | Aisha Patel (Support): Notified customer that manual credit memo was applied and that engineering follow-ups are scheduled. Marking status as In Progress until pipeline fix is deployed.
investigation_notes:
Findings: Settlement job attempted to update ledger rows while concurrent invoice generation performed a lock on the same ledger reference, triggering a DB deadlock. Root cause appears to be a race condition when downgrade events occur within a short window before invoice cutover. Reproducible in staging by forcing downgrade and scheduling invoice run immediately.
Hypotheses: 1) No strict ordering guarantee currently between credit settlement and invoice finalization; 2) Settlement job lacks aggressive retry/backoff for transient DB errors; 3) Race window widened by occasional queue delays in the billing scheduler during weekends.
Checks performed: - Reviewed job timestamps and DB deadlock trace. - Manually triggered settlement for affected credit and verified credit memo application succeeds. - Ran staging repro and reproduced deadlock when invoice job and settlement job run concurrently.
Next steps: Implement ordering fix (settlement -> invoice) and add retries. Add automated test to simulate downgrade-at-cutoff scenario.
resolution:
Manual remediation completed: created credit memo CM-20260311-559 and applied to INV-20260309-772. Customer invoice balance updated and customer confirmed.
Planned fix: Engineering to update billing pipeline to enforce settlement-before-invoice ordering and implement idempotent retry on settlement job. INT tickets opened for implementation (INT-8430, INT-8431).
Follow-up: Monitor next two billing cycles for other affected customers; add dashboard showing pending credits older than 12 hours. Targeted deployment date for pipeline fix: 2026-03-25.
